text: Managing a team is not easy, but it becomes simpler when you follow a few basic rules. First, communication is key: you must listen to your team members and share information clearly. Second, learn to delegate tasks properly, because you cannot do everything alone. Third, give regular feedback so people know how they are doing. Motivation is also important — thank your team for their hard work and celebrate success. Finally, when conflict appears, stay calm and solve it quickly. A good manager supports people, builds trust, and helps everyone work well together.
